defect: The stub dispatches a transaction without validating the interface descriptor, so a sender that presents no interface token at all still reaches the callback and the privileged action behind it.
fix: Read the interface token and compare it against GetDescriptor() before the switch.

parcel.note: the real Parcel implementation, compiled from the local checkout; it is what makes the observed behaviour attributable to the component rather than to a hand-written shim

cases.note: no interface token at all; a sender chooses its own token, including none
positive control: the fixed revision must still serve a well-formed request
a token belonging to a different interface

observable.meaning: the stub executed the callback and queued a message for the service loop, carrying the sender-chosen user id and content

known_limitations: Not reachability: the harness calls the stub directly. That a remote caller can reach this stub over real IPC, and under which ability registration and permission state, is not established here and stays an EvidenceObligation.
The interface token methods are supplied by a shim over the real Parcel; the shim forwards to WriteString16/ReadString16 and adds no policy.
MessageHandler::SendMessage records the call instead of dispatching it; the recording is the observable.
poc_compat.h supplies the using-directive for ErrorCode enumerators, which the historical header set does not expose unqualified; it changes no behaviour.
